text: It looks like a great app, honestly, BUT I only give 1 star because I'd like to try it for a few days before subscribing. And it doesn't have that option.
author: Tiffany Guzman
developer_reply: Hi, glad to hear you like the app! Most of the main features are free (you can close the paywall and keep exploring the app). We don’t offer a free trial because PRO features are either an extensions of free ones (behave the same as their free counterpart) or have a clickable Demo view with example data, so there's no "hidden PRO features" :)
